Mechanism

Why the loop reinforces itself

These steps distinguish the modeled mechanism from its visual and numerical outcomes.

1
Scores steer attention

Historic flags and linked contacts push patrols toward the same places again.

2
Attention lifts detections

More stops and checks create more recorded incidents without needing a large jump in true offending.

3
Recorded incidents harden stigma

Property value, watchlists, and neighborhood labels begin to move with the score, not just with the reality.
